text: Imputation (in law) [Lat. imputare , to impute]: Ger. Zurechnung; Fr. imputation ; Ital. imputazione . The attribution to a particular person of legal responsibility for an act; it is properly used only of free actions and their natural consequences (see Wolff's Inst ., chap. i. § 3). Imputation is also used by civilians to signify an appropriation of payments where there are several debts and enough is not paid to satisfy all. ( S.E.B. )
